title: Sean McVay: Myles Garrett, Puka Nacua likely to return to practice next week

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay: Myles Garrett, Puka Nacua likely to return to practice next week
sources.description: Rams stars Myles Garrett and Puka Nacua remained sidelined by their injuries, but they should be able to return to the field sooner than later — though it may not be this week.
